context_requirements: Active Wnt/beta-catenin signaling, ideally with detectable nuclear beta-catenin or TCF/LEF reporter activity
Expression of CTNNB1 and core Wnt pathway components
APC or CTNNB1 alterations that drive beta-catenin-dependent transcription may increase sensitivity
Proliferative capacity so that loss of beta-catenin-driven proliferation can be observed
falsifiers: No decrease in canonical beta-catenin target genes such as CCND1, MYC, MMP1, MMP2, CD44, COL1A1, or COL4A1 at 6 or 24 h in any responsive line
No increase in negative feedback genes such as AXIN1, TLE1, or CTNNAL1 at 6 h
No antiproliferative or G1-arrest signature at 24 h in lines with active Wnt signaling
Strong and equal transcriptional responses in all nine lines regardless of Wnt pathway status
Predominant upregulation of beta-catenin target genes rather than downregulation
